events.title: v0.2.9.5: Food Update - Burger Joint
events.summary: DISCLAIMER - NOT ALL FEATURES ARE FULLY TESTED AND THERE WILL BE BUGSIf you come across any issues, don't hesitate to fill out a feedback form or hit me up in the discord. There are some know bugs which will be listed and updated in the discord soon. A hot fix will be soon to follow!Here it is everyone: The Burger Joint is open!Grab a meal at the counter or use the drive-through. Orders come on physical trays, and you can open the boxes, unwrap your burgers, and eat between jobs. Other food type

events.title: Tie Down Official Discord
events.summary: Hey everyone! I'd love to invite you to Tie Down's official Discord! Whether you've been playing the demo or you're just checking out the game, come hang out and say hello.Help shape the game. Share feedback, report bugs, and tell me what you'd love to see. Find your delivery crew. Meet other players and find someone to blame when the cargo goes missing. Join the conversation. Ask questions, share clips, or show off your custom ride and cool screenshots. Tie Down is still in active development,
